# Queryable

> Queryable is a Maven plugin that generates Hibernate filters and JAX-RS controllers for Quarkus applications using Hibernate Panache.

- Documentation: https://queryable.dev/docs/
- Getting started: https://queryable.dev/docs/getting-started.html
- Full agent-oriented reference: https://queryable.dev/llms-full.txt
- Source: https://github.com/n-essio/queryable
- Maven coordinates: it.n-ess.queryable:queryable-maven-plugin
- Supported Java: 21

The plugin exposes `queryable:install`, `queryable:source`, and `queryable:sourcev4`.
Use the repository README, AGENTS.md, and API.MD for authoritative usage details.
